tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground under everything, and the base the aurora paints on. Text sits on it through `glass` panels, never bare on the aurora.

tokens.name: canvas-deep
tokens.usage: Second stop of the page gradient and the colour behind modals and the rail. Decorative; carries no text.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Aurora blob 1 (drifting glow). Painted by `Aurora` at no more than 50% strength, so text on glass stays above 7:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: aurora-sky
tokens.usage: Aurora blob 2 (powder-blue glow). Capped at 50% strength like its siblings.

tokens.name: aurora-rose
tokens.usage: Aurora blob 3 (pink glow); also the colour the aurora leans towards on success moments and idle sulks.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of resting panels, cards and rows. Translucent: put `ink`, `ink-soft` or `ink-muted` on it. Becomes opaque under reduced-transparency or high-contrast preferences.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of anything that floats above other glass: command bar, menus, bloom dialogs, the island, tooltips. Near-opaque so text keeps its contrast over whatever is behind.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The bright 1px rim along the top and left of every glass surface. Decorative highlight; never the only thing that separates two surfaces.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside glass (table rules, row gaps, chart grid). Decorative; use `control-edge` for anything the user must find.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, checkboxes, switches and sliders at rest. At least 3:1 against every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on `canvas`, `glass`, `glass-strong`. 7:1 or better on all of them in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, wit lines, row meta) on `canvas`, `glass`, `glass-strong`. 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, helper text, timestamps, on `canvas`, `glass`, `glass-strong`. At least 4.5:1. Never for anything required to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active nav glyphs, selected text, caret and focus tint, on `canvas` and glass. Text-safe (4.5:1 or better) in every theme.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The hot-pink wink: highlights, counters, the idle-sulk tint. Text-safe on glass; use sparingly, one spark per view.

tokens.name: grad-start
tokens.usage: Left/top stop of the primary pill gradient and the hold-to-confirm ring. Pair with `grad-end`; text on it is `on-grad`.

tokens.name: grad-end
tokens.usage: Right/bottom stop of the primary pill gradient. Pair with `grad-start`.

tokens.name: on-grad
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on the primary pill gradient (white in light themes, deep ink in dark ones). 4.5:1 or better on both gradient stops.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn solid at 2px with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and glyphs, and the gem tint. Always paired with a word and a tick icon. Leans teal so it parts company with `danger` for red-green colour blindness.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and glyphs, and the gem tint. Always paired with a word and a triangle icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text and glyphs, and the gem tint. Always paired with a word and a cross icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and glyphs, and the gem tint. Always paired with a word and an info icon.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (violet). Marks and swatches only: labels stay in `ink`. Series colours follow the entity, in this order, never cycled. Checked as a set for colour-blind separation.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (amber). Marks and swatches only. Differs from `data-1` in lightness and hue for protan, deutan and tritan viewers.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (sky blue). Marks and swatches only. A fourth series folds into "Other" or a small multiple.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmer behind modals and the command bar, under the blur. Decorative.

families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

shadow.note: Glows, not grey drop shadows: depth is tinted violet and pink. Each token is a complete box-shadow value; combine them with the `Glass` rim.

tokens.name: glow-rest
tokens.usage: Resting glass panels and rows.

tokens.name: glow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dragged rows (lift & shuffle), pressed-and-held items.

tokens.name: glow-float
tokens.usage: Overlays: command bar, bloom dialogs, the island, tooltips.

tokens.name: halo-pill
tokens.usage: The halo under the glowing gradient primary pill.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: A luminous 1px rim for glass buttons and chips.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii, and the saturation boost that keeps frosted layers from looking washed out.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, gems, tooltips.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, rail, the standard frosted layer.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays, the command bar, bloom dialogs, scrim.

tokens.name: blur-aurora
tokens.usage: Softening of the aurora blobs themselves.

tokens.name: sat-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter saturate() paired with the blur on every glass layer.

tokens.usage: Floating bulk-action bar from lasso select.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: Navigation rail.

tokens.name: z-bloom
tokens.usage: Bloom overlays: dialogs, menus, popovers, with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-cmd
tokens.usage: Command bar.

tokens.name: z-hint
tokens.usage: Hint overlay letter labels.

tokens.name: z-island
tokens.usage: The dynamic-island toast.

tokens.name: z-tip

duration.note: Motion is springy by default. Every duration collapses to 1ms when the user prefers reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover tints, press feedback, tooltip fade.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Most spring moves: toggles, tabs, rows, bloom close.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Bloom open, island expand, view morph, celebrations.

tokens.name: dur-hold
tokens.usage: How long a hold-to-confirm must be held.

tokens.name: dur-aurora
tokens.usage: One lap of the aurora drift.

easing.note: ease-spring overshoots about 5% and settles: the default for anything that arrives. ease-settle is the no-bounce version for fades and opacity.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Arrivals, presses, toggles, blooms: anything that should feel alive.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Exits, fades, colour changes: smooth, no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Dragging back to rest and hold-to-confirm release.
